body: At 17 or 18, the people around you can shape how you think, what you attempt and how far you push yourself. Mesa brings together students who are already building companies, launching products and taking ideas into the real world. The result is a peer group that challenges you to think bigger from Day 1. Apply now for Mesa’s UG Program.
headline: Find Your Tribe of Business Builders at Mesa
